html:
Teleporters can move a player from one location to another instantaneously. Usually this requires merely walking on the teleporter; however, in some cases a sacrifice is needed.

Teleporters

Name Move Walk Notes
A Soulpit ✗ ✗
Active Spirit Vortex ✗ ✓ Part of a boss fight during the Soul War Quest.
Death Portal ✗ ✓ It's connected to the Death element.

The portal in the Halls of Hope is part of the Forgotten Knowledge Quest, the one in the Lycanthrope Grounds is part of the Grimvale Quest.

Donut Gate ✗ ✗ To gain access to use the Donut Gate teleport to Candia you must progress through the Threatened Dreams Quest - Sweet Dreams.
Earth Archway ✗ ✓ Earth Archways will teleport premium players with level 30 or higher to one of the two Earth Shrines. This archway can be found along with the other three: Ice, Fire, and Energy.


See also: Holy Shrines

Earth Portal ✗ ✓ It's connected to the Earth element. Gain access to this teleporter through the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
Enchanted Guarded Crystal Sphere ✗ ✗ Teleports a player to the Blue Valley when used.
Energy Archway ✗ ✓ Energy Archways will teleport premium players with level 30 or higher to one of the two Energy Shrines. This archway can be found along with the other three: Ice, Earth, and Fire.


See also: Holy Shrines

Energy Gate ✗ ✓ A gate of pure, pulsing energy.
Energy Portal ✗ ✓ It's connected to the Energy element. Gain access to this teleporter through the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
Energy Vein (Marapur) ✗ ✓ To gain access to Marapur you must progress through Within The Tides Quest up to building the Asuri Talisman .
Fire Archway ✗ ✓ Fire Archways will teleport premium players with level 30 or higher to one of the two Fire Shrines. This archway can be found along with the other three: Ice, Earth, and Energy.

See also: Holy Shrines

Fire Portal ✗ ✓ It's connected to the Fire element. Gain access to this teleporter through the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
Fury Gate ✗ ✓ Fury Gates will teleport promoted premium players with level 60 or higher to the Fury Dungeon.
Glowing Vortex ✗ ✓ If you walk on it you are teleported to another place.
Guarded Crystal Sphere ✗ ✗ Teleports a player in the Blue Valley to the Adventurer's Guild.
Hive Gate ✗ ✗ It can teleport you to the other side of the wall if you are eligible to. You can enter it by receiving pheromones during the War Against the Hive Quest.
Holy Portal ✗ ✓ It's connected to the Holy element. Gain access to this teleporter through the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
Hot Geyser ✗ ✓ Walk on it to be teleported one floor up.
It looks the same as an Inactive Geyser.
Ice Archway ✗ ✓ Ice Archways will teleport premium players with level 30 or higher to one of the two Ice Shrines. This archway can be found along with the other three: Earth, Fire, and Energy.


See also: Holy Shrines

Ice Portal ✗ ✓ It is connected to the Ice element. In the Halls of Hope, access to it is gained through the Forgotten Knowledge Quest.
Instable Vortex ✗ ✓ Teleports the player to another location:
  • Lower Roshamuul lava cave. teleports the player to an area outside the caves.
  • Roshamuul Serpent Maze Shiversleep chamber, teleports the player to the reward room.
Large Crystal Teleporter (Berg) ✗ ✓ Unlike the darker version, this teleporter does not require Teleport Crystals.
Large Crystal Teleporter ✗ ✓ Used to teleport from several cities to the GCTS. The player must have a Teleport Crystal, which is used up like Orichalcum Pearls, in their inventory to teleport. For the warzones, you need a Red Teleport Crystal. Travelling between the other Gnome areas require no crystals at all.
Large Glowing Amethyst ✗ ✓ A teleporter activated by stepping on it.
Large Glowing Emerald ✗ ✓ A teleporter activated by stepping on it.
Large Glowing Ruby ✗ ✓
Large Glowing Sapphire ✗ ✓ A teleporter activated by stepping on it.
Lavish Painting of a Jungle ✗ ✗ To gain access to Tropical Desolator you must progress through and complete the Between the Lines Quest.

When the boss room is occupied the painting will be shown with an idol in the center shown below.

Lavish Painting of a Library ✗ ✗ To gain access to Wrathful Archivist you must progress through and complete the Between the Lines Quest.

When the boss room is occupied the painting will be shown with lit torches around the bookcase as shown below.

Lavish Painting of a Ship ✗ ✗ To gain access to Blight Mariner you must progress through and complete the Between the Lines Quest.

When the boss room is occupied the painting will be shown with tentacles around the ship as shown below.

Loose Stone Pile (Omrabas) ✗ ✗ Use a Shovel or equivalent on it to be teleported downwards into Omrabas's room.
Looks the same as a Loose Stone Pile and a Wormhole.
Maelstrom ✗ ✓ If you just walk on it you are teleported to another place, like a Water Vortex.
Looks the same as a Water Vortex and a Water Channel.
Magic Door ✗ ✗ Use it to get teleported into or out of Eclesius' house. There are two known doors: a free-standing door outside of the Adventurer's Guild, and one built in the house of Eclesius.
Magic Forcefield (Green) ✗ ✓ A green Magic Forcefield. Looks the same as a Disruption.
Magic Forcefield (Orange) ✗ ✓ It is an Orange Magic Forcefield.
Magic Forcefield ✗ ✓ A Magic Forcefield is a game square that will teleport your character to a different location when you step on it. Portals cannot be moved, but some may only appear under special circumstances, such as flipping a switch, or placing an item in a specific location. Also, sometimes a portal is present, but it will only teleport you to a special place if you flip a switch or series of switches. Otherwise, it just teleports you to the next square.

Azerus and Versperoth turn into magic forcefields upon death.
Looks the same as a Ship Core and can also appear green.
See also: Mystic Flame

Mechanism (Teleporter) ✗ ✗ You can only use them (and get past gates) after starting certain missions in the In Service of Yalahar Quest. If you do not meet the requirements a message will appear saying:
The gate mechanism won't move. You probably have to find a way around until you figure out how to operate the gate.
Mystic Flame ✗ ✓ Mystic Flames have various purposes, most prominently they act as Teleports, as in the Ankrahmun Tombs which teleport the player deeper if they sacrifice a Scarab Coin in a Coal Basin. Other flames, such as the flames inside Morguthis' Deathslicer Arena, are scripted in other ways that do not act as teleports.
Naga Boat ✗ ✗ When using a naga boat for transportation throughout Marapur there are four areas in which you can travel which are listed below.

When you land here (33777, 32661, 7) in the Murming Wilderness you will be greeted with the following:

  • The small boat sails you northward, along the coastline of Marapur.

When you land here (33904, 32760, 7) in the Emerald Gardens you will be greeted with the following:

  • The small boat sails you eastward, along the coastline of Marapur.

When you land here (33789, 32869, 7) in Silvertides you will be greeted with the following:

  • The small boat sails you southward, along the coastline of Marapur.

When you land here (33633, 32771, 7) in the Fading Isles you will be greeted with the following:

  • The small boat sails you westward, along the coastline of Marapur.
Old Flying Carpet ✗ ✓ Stepping on it sends a player to Thais temple.
Ominous Trashcan ✗ ✓ To gain access to use these teleporters you must progress through the 20 Years a Cook Quest.
Omnious Cauldron ✗ ✓ Omnious Cauldrons will teleport you into the lair of The Great Schnitzel
Ore Wagon ✗ ✗ Used to transport people, coal and other cargo. Only the ones in Kazordoon and Beregar can actually be used, though; tickets to travel around in Kazordoon can be bought from Ore Wagon System Ticket Seller NPCs. The ones in Beregar are part of a quest and can be used for free.
Portal (Ascending) ✗ ✓ This portal will teleport your character to a different location when you step on it.
Portal (Ellipse) ✗ ✓ This portal is first used to initially access Marapur through the quest Within the Tides, it is then also used to access the boss Timira the Many-Headed.
Slab with a Hyaena ✗ ✓ It is used as the portal to access Katex Blood Tongue.
Slab with a Lizard ✗ ✓ It is used as the portal to access Yirkas Blue Scales.
Slab with a Scorpion ✗ ✓ It is used as the portal to access Utua Stone Sting.
Slab with a Skull ✗ ✓ This is utilized as a teleportation method throughout the Netherworld, aswell as serving as a swift passage out of Iksupan for a convenient return from Ahau.
Slab with a Snake ✗ ✓ It is used as the portal to access Srezz Yellow Eyes.
Slime Slide ✗ ✓ Transportation system on Oramond.
Spheric Teleporter ✗ ✗
Strange Carving ✗ ✓ Strange carvings almost always require a sacrifice to work. There are four different strange carvings:

See also: Strange Carving (Tile)

Strange Vortex (Teleporter) ✗ ✓ When a Minion of Gaz'haragoth dies, its corpse turns into a vortex which leads to an area with Nightmares of Gaz'haragoth.
Looks the same as a Strong Water Vortex and a Vortex of Elemental Water.
Strange Whirl ✗ ✓ It appears to be a small tornado.
Can be seen on the pixel art of Eternal Winter.
Summer Court Portal ✗ ✓ To gain access to the Summer Court teleport you must progress through The Dream Courts Quest.
Teleporter Vortex ✗ ✓ You cannot look directly at this object, as you'll get the message from the object beneath it instead.
Turtle ✗ ✓ They seem to be treated as pets by mermaids, and can be used for transportation between islands that do not have normal seaports. Simply stepping onto a sea turtle will cause it to transport you to a nearby island, but only if you have permission to use them. Sea turtle transports are protection zones. Throwing lootbags on the turtle won't work, you will have to use the royal mailbox on the Laguna Islands instead.
Vortex (Green) ✗ ✓ If you just walk on it you are teleported to another place. See also: Vortex
Vortex (Purple) ✗ ✓ If you just walk on it you are teleported to another place.

See also: Vortex

Vortex (Red) ✗ ✓ If you just walk on it you are teleported to another place. See also: Vortex
Vortex of Creation Lore ✗ ✓ It's part of the fight against The Scourge of Oblivion during The Secret Library Quest.
Vortex of Destruction Lore ✗ ✓ It's part of the fight against The Scourge of Oblivion during The Secret Library Quest.
Water Channel ✗ ✓ If you just walk on it you are teleported to another place, like a Water Vortex.
Looks the same as a Maelstrom and a Water Vortex.
Water Vortex ✗ ✓ If you just walk on it you are teleported to another place.
Looks the same as a Maelstrom and a Water Channel.

If you step in the one east of Banuta, you will receive the achievement Spectulation.

Winter Court Portal ✗ ✓ To gain access to the Winter Court teleport you must progress through The Dream Courts Quest.

See also other Objects.
